title: Entrance of Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing at night
objects_and_counts: Two illuminated streetlamp-style poles with spherical globes are visible in the paved forecourt; both are fully visible and unobscured and stand near the entrance under the canopy.
At least two people are visible on the far left walkway outside the building; they are small and distant (cropped by distance) and appear as silhouettes.
The building entrance shows a continuous glazed facade with multiple full-height glass panels and at least one double glass door centered under the canopy.
Two vertical structural columns/pillars are visible supporting the canopy at the entrance (one near the left glass wall and one partly visible near the right glass wall).
Multiple lit rectangular windows are visible on the upper floor of the building above the canopy (at least two distinct lit window openings).
A wide illuminated horizontal sign/band runs across the canopy above the entrance bearing text (see visible_text for exact transcription).
spatial_relations: The illuminated horizontal sign band with the text 'TAM WING FAN INNOVATION WING' is located on the canopy directly above the main entrance glass doors.
Two spherical-globe lamp posts stand on the paved forecourt in front of the entrance; one is slightly left-of-center relative to the entrance and the other slightly right-of-center.
The glass facade spans horizontally under the canopy; the double-door entrance is centered beneath the illuminated sign band with glass panels continuing to both left and right.
The distant walkway and two small silhouetted people are to the far left of the building facade, beyond the left glass wall.
Upper-floor lit windows are directly above the canopy and sign, aligned approximately over the entrance area.
colours_and_materials: The canopy sign band is lit with a cool white/blue-white illumination.
The spherical lamp globes emit a warm yellow-orange light.
The forecourt is paved with reddish-brown bricks or tiles visible under the lamps.
The building facade is mainly transparent glass panels with metal framing; some interior areas show warm interior lighting.
uncertainties: Small text adjacent to or below the main 'TAM WING FAN INNOVATION WING' band is present but not legible in the image; transcribed here as '[unreadable]'.
Any smaller labels, room numbers, or additional wording on the facade or columns could not be read at this image resolution and distance.
